description: [forged] Decodes an x402 'PAYMENT-REQUIRED' style payload (accepts a base64-encoded string or raw JSON) into a readable summary. For each entry in the 'accepts' array it returns scheme, network, asset, payTo, maxTimeoutSeconds, description, resource, mimeType, the raw atomic amount, and priceUsd computed by dividing maxAmountRequired by 10^decimals when the asset matches a known stablecoin contract address (e.g. USDC on Base/Ethereum/Polygon); otherwise decimals/priceUsd are null. Pure offline computation, no network access. (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

payload.description: Base64-encoded or raw JSON string of the x402 payment-required payload (either a single payment-requirements object or an object with an 'accepts' array).

name: x402_payment_decode
